notes.title: Update Notes for v1.18.18 - Speedrunning Improvements
notes.notes:
Attention Gawds of Hoop! A major update focused on quality-of-life improvements and speedrunning support is available!

Speedrunning & Gameplay Features

 Sprint ability added — built with speedrunners in mind.
 Restart level option added for quick resets and perfecting runs.
 Trials now end with a clear screen that shows if you beat your timer or golf best score.
 Reworked several levels to improve flow and optimization for speedrunning.
 Trial Specific Bug Fixes.


Tutorial & UI Improvements

 Added tutorial text at the beginning of the game, and in multiplayer, to clarify objectives and mechanics.
 Reworked UI across the game to be cleaner, more readable, and easier to navigate.


Audio Overhaul

 Each trial now has its own unique music to keep the vibe fresh as you progress.
 Ambient and feedback sounds improved for a more responsive experience.
 New sound effects added to:

 Hoops
 Menu buttons



New Configure Menu

 Moved settings out of the Select Trial screen into a dedicated Configure Menu.
 Added new customization options:

 Mouse sensitivity
 Invert look
 Windowed/fullscreen selection


Thanks for playing Hoop Gawds! Whether you're here for the wild hoop mechanics or hunting for that next best run, this update is for you.

— Ryan
